message.content: {"label":"sufficient","reason":"The combined passages explicitly state both the gross IPO proceeds and the net proceeds to Uber, with explicit note that net proceeds are approximately $8.0 billion after deductions, and that the private placement with PayPal ($500 million) and selling-stockholder proceeds are not part of Uber’s net proceeds.","supported_requirements":[{"requirement":"Gross IPO proceeds","passage_rank":2,"quote":"Per Share | Per Share |  |  | Total | Total | $ | 8,100,000,000"},{"requirement":"Estimated net proceeds excluding PayPal private placement and selling-stockholder proceeds","passage_rank":5,"quote":"We estimate that net proceeds to us from the sale of our common stock in this offering will be approximately $8.0 billion after deducting the underwriting discounts and commissions and estimated offering expenses payable by us. Additionally, our proceeds from the private placement to PayPal will be $500 million. We will not receive any proceeds from the sale of common stock in this offering by the selling stockholders."}],"missing_requirements":[],"concerns":[]}
